anchors.name: k2_18b_dms_not_uniquely_identifiable
anchors.derivation: Insufficient evidence for DMS and DMDS in the atmosphere of K2-18 b, A&A 700 (2025) A55: a joint reanalysis of JWST NIRISS, NIRSpec and MIRI finds the reported absorption features are not uniquely identifiable. Recorded as the scientific situation this task reproduces, not as a numeric target: value 1.0 is a marker that the claim was verified against the source.

anchors.name: k2_18b_competing_molecules_preferred
anchors.derivation: A systematic search for trace molecules in the atmosphere of K2-18 b: retrieval over 661 candidate molecules finds ethylene and chloroethane at least as favoured as, and in many cases preferred over, DMS/DMDS. This is the confusable-pair regime of the task, and the reason naming either member counts as a false discovery.

anchors.name: dms_dmds_mutually_degenerate_mid_infrared
anchors.derivation: New constraints on DMS and DMDS in the atmosphere of K2-18 b from JWST MIRI: the spectral features can be explained to a large extent by either molecule because of degeneracy in the mid-infrared. The task's pair is built to the same shape - templates correlated at 0.9997 after band averaging.

anchors.name: standards_of_evidence_dispute
anchors.derivation: K2-18 b does not meet the standards of evidence for life. Recorded because it is the clearest statement that the disputed axis is calibration of a claim rather than identification of a molecule, which is the axis this task scores separately from recovery.
